notes.title: UE 5.4 Update - New Arena Map
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 119 - Version 1.2.0.0

New Items: 
New warehouse building created
New Niagara bubbles for the tanning tub
Added a new large leather backpack
Added a Crude Wooden Club
Added a 2 Handed Axe
Added a Dagger/Knife weapon
Added Shovel
Added a Torch
Added 9 New Roman Soldier NPC's
Added 2nd Tier clothing and first armor for both Male and Female Characters
Added a reputation system that will affect the NPC interactions, if you become a criminal the guards will seek you out.
Added all the items that can be Brought / Sold at the Blacksmith Vendor
Added all the items that can be Brought / Sold at the Carpenter Vendor
Added all the items that can be Brought / Sold at the Farmer Vendor
Added all the items that can be Brought / Sold at the Fishing Vendor
Added all the items that can be Brought / Sold at the Herbalist Vendor
Added all the items that can be Brought / Sold at the Roman Commander Vendor
Added all the items that can be Brought / Sold at the Tailor Vendor
Added Club class and actors
Added Sword Class and Actors
Added Spear Class and Actors
Added Hatchet Class and Actors
Added Two handed Axe Class and Actors
New Arena Map, this will be a PVP testing area then part of the main game as a side game to earn loot.

Fix's:
Fixed up a few issues with the workstations.
Fixed up the backpack details
Fixed Health and Stamina Potion details
Fixed the stone tools/weapons details
Fixed the following animations: Sword/Spear/Hatchet
Added FP Animations to the Wooden Club
Fixed the Male and Female Character selection options
Fixed the Male Beard options
Fixed the Character Selection Menu UI


Changes:
Entire Project shifted to Unreal Engine 5.4

notes.title: Patch Notes 117 - Version 1.1.0.4
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 117 - Version 1.1.0.4

New Items: 
Added flocking birds to the environment
Added 3 new landscape materials: Path / Cliff Rock / Riverbed
Added a relationship value to the player
Added a Death Penalty - There is a death spawn timer, your dead body will only respawn every 30 min
Added Wild horses to the game
Added a taming system for the animals to the game.
Added different food types that need to be crafted for each animal to be able to tame them.
Added three farm fence sections: Gate, 2 post fence section, 3 post fence section.
Added Damage indicators to the NPC's and Animals but not Players
Added a Bull to go with the Cow
Added Voice to the NPC dialogue, you now don't have to read the text (text will be on screen if you miss anything in the speech)
Added a "Floor Lamp" which can be crafted from the Crafting Plan by the player.
Added a new compass to the Players HUD (top of screen)

Fix's:
Adjusted the Hard stamina rates and drain effects
You must now hold the correct food in your hand to tame the animal
Fixed the Mouse default speed, This can be changed in the settings but the "Default" is much slower.


Changes:
Changed the Tamed animal commands to actions rather than the onscreen list: Hold the animal food and they will follow, no food held they will wander (if inside a fenced section they can not go out of area)
Changed the Thirst and Hungar drain rates
Changed all the trees to Nanite Quality.
Changed the soil icon
Changed the Kiln and Furnace recipe to the Players Crafting Plan
Changed the Log building rope requirement to half the previous value
Changed the Boot screen
Changed the Main Menu and character creation

notes.title: Patch Notes 114
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 114 - Version 1.1.0.1

New Items: 
Added a mini map to the players Stats Screen
Character Creation page on main menu (still in progress, main functionality complete, details and options to be added)

Fix's: 
Birch Trees replaced with new Nanite models
Fixed the Hip weapon slot, can now attach weapons that suit that location (shorter types like knife/sword/hatchet

Changes:
Reduced the rain amount across all seasons
Added some more variables to the World/Player Temperature system

notes.title: Patch Notes 113 - Version 1.1.0.0
notes.notes:
Game back end updated to 5.2 to take advantage of new features and benefits.
New Map for single and co-op multiplayer games.
Larger Server map in progress for Dedicated server multiplayer game version.

notes.title: Patch Notes 111
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 111 - Version 1.0.1.1

New Items: 
1. Animation for drinking from a water source
2. Animation for filling water flask from water source
3. Added Auto save to the level, this should work in both MP & SP
4. Log building Thatch roof pieces
5. Revamped the farming system (Gardens) to include fertilizer, disease and a few other variable.
6. Added Fruit trees that can be planted almost anywhere and will harvest fruit that can be collected.


Fix's: 
1. Tools hitting the ground were giving Combat EXP, no EXP for hitting the ground with anything.
2. Spit the Combat and Hunting EXP gains to Hunting if you attack an animal, Combat if you attack a Player or NPC, plus the training Dummy which is not in game yet.
3. Fixed the skills menu not showing the mouse and changed the menu shutdown (EXIT Button) to close all Menus
4. Fixed a spelling error in the Charcoal item
5. Fixed a spelling error in the Survival Skill "Can Craft" description
6. Fixed door position in doorway after upgrade
7. Fixed Beech tree harvesting
8. Fixed Skill EXP and points not saving on death or load save game
9. Fixed food bars not loading on death or load save game.

Changes:
1. Changed Survival EXP gain to 25
2. New single or MP hosted game will start in spring now not winter
3. Changed the temp of the fire to give more warmth to character
4. Changed the "Is Cold" and "is freezing" temps to be lower so the character can withstand lower temps before these are triggered.
5. Changed animal death de spawn time from 30-60 sec
6. Changed the animations for the following: Spear/Sword/Hatchet/Knife
7. Removed the Oak trees as they were not Nanite ready and replaced with Beech trees.
8. Increased the trees cull distance from 25000 - 35000 (250M - 350M)

notes.title: Patch Notes 110
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 110 - Version 1.0.1.0

New Items: 
1. #6 from Previous Update. 
    Added Skill tree base - 5 separate trees to cover the main skills:
    6a. Survival Skills: Complete
    6b. Combat Skills: Complete
    6c. Hunting Skills: Complete
    6d. Extraction Skills: Complete
    6e. Production Skills: Complete
    6f. Diplomacy Skills: still in progress Removed for now.
2. Added campfire heat, only fair as the winter nights are getting cold so you will want to be close to a fire at night or during a storm


Fix's: 
1. Fixed the footsteps being too loud, they are now assigned to the Effects slider in the menu.
2. Fixed ability to place benches and other craft able furniture on top of each other, e.g.: campfire on top of campfire.
3. Fixed the Ore hit sounds
4. Fixed Katrea and Helga the Herbalist Vendor buy and sell lists; they now don't sell bread as they were.
5. Fixed Gardens after upgrade to 5.1, not plants need above a certain sunlight intensity so if overcast or foggy plants won't grow, also plants won't grow at night.

Changes:
1. Cleaned up all NPC's with new models
2. Cleaned up the Garden UI
3. Changed the torch light to give good direct small radius light but also a soft surrounding light that fades in the distance.
4. Changed the weapon slots so that you can select the hot bar slot rather than it auto selecting for you. (it's one more step though as you will need to equip the tool/weapon and then drag to the hot bar of your choice). if you are in a hurry, you can pick up a weapon from the ground straight into your hand and you can use it by selecting hold in the options when you look at it.

notes.title: Patch Notes 109
notes.notes:
New Items: 
1. Leopards have been added to the Map
2. Cleaned up the Jungle foliage
3. Added Soldier Camp to the map
4. Added a few roaming soldier patrols
5. Added aim offsets for both sword and hatchet
6. Added Skill tree base - 6 separate trees to cover the main skills:
    6a. Survival Skills: still in progress
    6b. Combat Skills: still in progress
    6c. Hunting Skills: still in progress
    6d. Extraction Skills: still in progress
    6e. Production Skills: still in progress

2. Fixed footstep sounds and applied them to the Effects volume in the settings menu.
3. Fixed the god rays in the ocean
4. Fixed character selection from Main Menu

2. Changed the Pine/Spruce trees to more realistic models
3. Increased the animal spawn count, there are now many more animals in the world but you will still need to hunt for them.
4. Changed the jungle and forest grass types
